comment: Off-board wiring diagram for a 5-loop true bypass looper with tuner mute and buffer switches; no values are printed anywhere. The small 4 x 3 buffer board is drawn bare (two cuts, no parts). Seven unlabelled LED resistors and seven 3PDT footswitches, which are the pedal's controls, are listed; the seven red indicator LEDs are drawn but not typed.
